name: Memphis
what_it_means: Inspired by the Memphis Group (Milan, 1981), this style is a playful explosion of squiggles, zig-zags, confetti shapes, terrazzo, bright pastels and bold black outlines. It is cheeky, retro and anti-serious, great for brands that want personality.
signature_moves: Squiggles, zig-zags, dots, triangles as decoration
best_for: Kids brands, snacks & drinks, creative events, social apps
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a landing page for [FUN BRAND] in a 1980s Memphis style. Cream background (#FFF4E0) scattered with confetti decorations: black squiggles, zig-zag lines, polka-dot triangles, half circles and terrazzo specks in pink #FF6F91, teal #3EC1D3, yellow #FFC93C and purple #7A5CFA. Shapes have thick black outlines. Headline in a chunky rounded geometric font (Fredoka / Righteous) with a coloured offset shadow. Product image sits on a geometric plinth. Buttons are pill-shaped with black borders. Decorations gently bob on hover.
